page_title: BRE 2-2 AUX | Brest v Auxerre 14/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' Kenny Lala (Brest) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+2' Assane Diousse (Auxerre) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
90+1' Auxerre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Aye (Auxerre) replacing Lassine Sinayoko.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The manager makes a subsitution with Assane Diousse (Auxerre) coming on for Han-Noah Massengo.
90' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Auxerre win a corner kick.
88' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Luc Zogbe (Brest) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
85' Problems for Christophe Pelissier as Ki-Jana Hoever is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ange Loic N'Gatta (Auxerre) replaces him.
85' None of the Brest players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
83' The game is interrupted now, Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' 18:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
79' 2 - 2 GOAL! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) scores with a header from close range after Mama Balde headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 2:2.
78' Here is a change. Justin Bourgault is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Luc Zogbe (Brest).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Romain Faivre (Brest) comes onto the pitch so that Kamory Doumbia can be given a rest.
77' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Mama Balde (Brest).
74' 1 - 2 Goal! Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
72' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
72' We are about to witness a very dangerous free kick from the edge of the box! Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) will be the one to show us his shooting technique.
71' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' The substitution has been made. Kevin Danois (Auxerre) has replaced Theo Bair.
67' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Donovan Leon comes off his line to intercept.
64' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Close! Abdallah Sima (Brest) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
60' Brest are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
60' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Hugo Magnetti and he is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Brest).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mahdi Camara leaves the pitch and Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) comes on.
59' Marco Bizot displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Theo Bair (Auxerre) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

57' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
55' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. Brest are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
51' The ratio of the ball possession is 64:36.
48' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' Auxerre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Auxerre are going to take it.
46' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Christophe Pelissier probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Hamed Junior Traore. He is replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
45+4' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players.
45+4' Brest are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
45+3' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastien Dechepy no option but to blow his whistle.
45+2' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Mama Balde (Brest) inside the box.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Auxerre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) picks up the rebound just outside the box and releases a weak low shot straight at the goalkeeper who saves.
40' Great save! Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Marco Bizot.
39' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Brest players look gutted.
39' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Brest players aren’t happy.

37' What a GOAL that is! Mama Balde (Brest) showed great determination to get to the ball inside the box and acrobatically launched himself into the air and produced a scissor kick of the highest quality to leave Donovan Leon helpless. He makes it 1:1.
34' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Donovan Leon pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
33' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

31' Mahdi Camara (Brest) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
31' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Brest out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
30' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.

29' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.

28' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Donovan Leon. This effort really didn't trouble him.
27' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Mama Balde (Brest) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
24' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' Eric Roy is forced to make a change. Ibrahim Salah (Brest) is unable to continue due to injury, Mama Balde comes on.
20' Theo Bair (Auxerre) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.

20' That didn't go as planned! Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Marco Bizot, who easily kept it out.
18' 0 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Theo Bair and Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 0:1.
17' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.
14' Wonderful movement by Brest. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
12' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
8' Theo Bair (Auxerre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. Brest are awarded a free kick.
7' Brest are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
5' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
2' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Brest will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
